name: Breaking the Silence
history: Breaking the Silence es un grupo activo desde 2013, de estilo metalcore con influencias Trivium, As I Lay Dying, Silent Civilian, Killswitch Engage, Memphis May Fire, Parkway Drive, Dawn of the Maya, Rise of Fury y Tragic Vision.
historyEn: Breaking the Silence is a band active since 2013, of metalcore style with influences Trivium, As I Lay Dying, Silent Civilian, Killswitch Engage, Memphis May Fire, Parkway Drive, Dawn of the Maya, Rise of Fury and Tragic Vision.
